as_told.title: Three-fingered being's touch and the download

plain: In 2019, a quantum computing researcher named Deep Prasad says, his bedroom roof "like dissolves" and he saw "the underside of a rectangular craft" above him, with gray beings in the room. He says a being with three fingers touched him and he received a sudden rush of knowledge, beginning with the thought "that the universe is teeming with life." Prasad tells it twice in the same interview, the second time adding the touch and the download. To him it means contact with other beings is real and can pass on ideas.
